# Governance: who does what

*Generated by `check.py` from the map's elements. Don't edit it: change the elements, then run it.*

From the steps on the map: who **does** each step (the role assigned to it), who **answers** for it (the role of the person who owns what it writes) and who's **told** (the roles of the steps that read what it writes). Who's consulted isn't on the map: it's agreed in each step.

| Step | ROL-001 data governance lead | ROL-002 data owner | ROL-003 data steward | ROL-007 analytics engineer | ROL-008 requester |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| STP-001 ask for a term | answers |  | told |  | does |
| STP-002 draft the definition | answers | told | does |  |  |
| STP-003 decide | told | does, answers |  |  |  |
| STP-004 publish in the glossary | does | answers | told | told |  |
| STP-005 sync to every tool |  | answers | told | does |  |
